$comment: Hand-curated purposes for docs/PHASE_3_REVIEW_INDEX.md, read by scripts/phase3-review-index.ts. Only for files whose header comment and introducing commit subject say too little; every key must be a path the index lists, or the check fails.

purposes.package.json: The root workspace manifest: the workspaces, the `npm run` commands every gate and CI step calls, the dev tooling and the overrides.
purposes.package-lock.json: The npm lockfile: the exact dependency tree `npm ci` installs.
purposes.apps/api/package.json: The API workspace manifest; Phase 3 adds the `@daftar/inventory` dependency.
purposes.apps/web/package.json: The merchant web workspace manifest: its dependencies and its test script.
purposes.apps/web/src/messages/ar.json: The Arabic message catalogue of the merchant web.
purposes.apps/web/src/messages/en.json: The English message catalogue of the merchant web.
purposes.apps/web/src/messages/tr.json: The Turkish message catalogue of the merchant web.
purposes.packages/inventory/package.json: The `@daftar/inventory` package manifest: its build and test scripts.
purposes.packages/inventory/tsconfig.json: The `@daftar/inventory` TypeScript configuration for type-checking source and tests.
purposes.packages/inventory/tsconfig.build.json: The `@daftar/inventory` TypeScript configuration for the published build.
purposes.infrastructure/database/MIGRATION_MANIFE: The migration manifest: the SHA-256 of every frozen migration and the frozen boundary the gates check.
